title: Example 1 — comment contradicts code (REPORT)
output:
- location: users.py:2
- issue: The comment claims the function returns age in years, but it returns age in days.
- severity: high
- suggested_fix: Update the comment to "returns the user's age in DAYS", or divide by 365 if years were intended.
why: REPORTED because the comment's claimed behavior (years) contradicts the actual code behavior (days) — a REPORT category. The plausible alternative was to skip it as a harmless doc nit, but a wrong unit in a comment misleads every caller and causes downstream bugs, so it qualifies and is rated high, not low.
